input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

This scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？：请问，我们可以吃什么植物？，“麻烦” does not introduce a question in this way; “请问” is the polite question-opening expression. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 以后：后来，“后来” introduces an event that happened afterwards, while sentence-initial “以后” normally follows a stated time or event. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，“别人” means people other than a specified speaker or group; here the general group being told is “人们”. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，This is a completed narrative action that happens later, so it needs 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “麻烦” needs a verb such as 告诉 here, while 请问 correctly opens the question.
Sentence-initial 以后 needs a stated time or event before it, whereas 后来 is correct here.
别人 excludes the relevant speaker or group, while 人们 correctly refers to people in general.
This later narrative action is completed, so 告诉了 correctly supplies perfective 了.
